criteria.justification: Specific integrations, performance targets and reconciliation design.
criteria.evidence: The solution uses a modular API gateway, event-driven services and an offline retry queue for CRM and ERP integrations.

criteria.justification: Defined stages and acceptance checks, but training detail is limited.
criteria.evidence: Delivery takes 16 weeks: discovery in weeks 1-3, build in weeks 4-10, migration in weeks 11-13 and acceptance in weeks 14-16.

criteria.justification: Transparent total cost and exclusions, but premium pricing.
criteria.evidence: Three-year total cost is USD 420,000, excluding taxes and buyer-side network upgrades.

criteria.justification: Concrete identity, encryption, retention and recovery controls; external assurance remains a claim.
criteria.evidence: Controls include SAML SSO, role-based access, AES-256 storage encryption, TLS 1.3 transport and 365-day audit logs.

criteria.justification: Round-the-clock critical support and comparable projects; resolution commitment is absent.
criteria.evidence: Support is available 24/7 for critical incidents, with a 30-minute response target and a named service manager.

risks: Highest three-year price in this cohort.
Training capacity and resolution SLA need clarification.
overall_summary: Strong technical and security evidence, with a premium total cost and a moderate delivery schedule.
